q1.question: How long does the repair take?
q1.answer: Most repairs are completed within 1-2 business days. Complex cases may take longer, and we will inform you in advance.

q2.question: Do you offer warranty on repairs?
q2.answer: Yes, we provide warranty on all performed work and installed parts in accordance with German law.

q3.question: How can I get a quote?
q3.answer: Click the 'Get a Quote in 1 Minute' button and leave your contact details. We will call you back and provide the exact price.

q4.question: Do you repair older devices?
q4.answer: We focus on modern technology. We do not repair very old or outdated devices as it is not economically viable.

q5.question: Can I drop off my device in person?
q5.answer: Yes, you can bring your device to our workshop at Offenbacher Landstraße 306. We are open Mon-Sat from 11:00 to 19:00.
